name: Amoroso
source: A young and wealthy noblewoman distantly related to the Hierophant's family who rules a prosperous city that is a hub of trade. Orphaned at a young age she was raised by her family retainers to become a great noble lady, but she is bored with her life. She possesses one of the Four Great Icons, and her Arcana is the Empress.
